preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each string P must have a length between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for c in P)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string P must be either '#' or '.'.
The first and last characters of P must be '#'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of days required to cross the passage for each test case.
